copy_gaps: The method (frame 2): §6.3 L548-550 names its three parts — what each source counts, why per-order arrival needs a per-order feed, why exact sources carry no (estimated) badge (C-2.13; `14` §0.5 rule 2) — and writes no text. The placeholders' 'E18-D05 (#499)' tag rests on L18 alone (new copy is PROPOSED for E18-D05's copy deck): §14 (L892-914) has no GAP row for the method and §16's E18-D05 line (L937) hands over only 'every copy marked PROPOSED'. Routing request for the spec author (to raise on PR #4180; this offline round posts nothing, so no GAP id exists to cite): a §14 GAP row 'the CMP-069 method text for SCR-032's data source → E18-D05 (#499), E18-S05 (#630)'. Facts it can quote: §6.3 L543-545 (Aggregated volume merges prints at the same price, side and millisecond within 0–100 ms; Trade count counts prints); E18-S05 Scope (traded volume: 'cells count quantity'; number of trades: 'print counts instead of quantity'); R7's sentence; C-2.13 L168 ('Bybit provides no L3/MBO feed'); §4.4 L298 and §7.4 L710 (FootprintImbalance.estimated is false for every v1 source).
CMP-069's title (`15` L677 `title` prop) and the i's accessible name: not given; neither is drawn.
Each source's one-line accessible description (L544-545): not given; not drawn (an accessible description, not visible text).
No announcement is named for opening or closing the i (§6.3; E18-D04's policy table, §16 L936).
The window's '50' is the sketch's (L470) and §6.2 L530's '50 ms drawn'; the spec states no default within 0–100 ms.
live_checks: Frame 1: the crop at x 24, y 32, about 544 × 143 px, hugging the group; nothing else in the frame.

Frame 2: the crop about 544 × 214 px; the i expanded (the color.surface.selected fill) with its 2 px focus-ring inner stroke; CMP-069's region under the sentence, its left edge on the sentence's (x 28 in the group), three placeholder lines in type.ui.caption, dark grey.
R7's sentence: 3 lines at 464 px by the kit's estimate in both frames; if Penpot wraps it differently, it must wrap the same in both frames (same node, same width).

The sources row: one line at 496 px (493 px est., a 3 px margin); an offline HTML preview with a wider fallback font wrapped 'Trade count (prints)' to a second line, the window field staying beside 'Aggregated volume, window': if Penpot wraps it too, that is the dialog's own wrap at this width (boards 07-10 use the same kit row), not a defect.
No inst node on this board: every control is a composition, so there is no library set, variant or text layer to verify.
rename frame 'SCR-032∕data-source' to 'SCR-032/data-source' after the board's last section (Penpot shows 'SCR-032 / data-source')
rename frame 'SCR-032∕data-source-method' to 'SCR-032/data-source-method' after the board's last section (Penpot shows 'SCR-032 / data-source-method')
root: after the first section the root must read back exactly as the sheet's board.name
deviations: The window field is named 'CMP-008 NumericStepperInput (composition)': A-37 (L889) names SCR-032's window field as CMP-008 and `14` SCR-032's components list CMP-008 (`14` L778); e18kit's field() names any non-select field CMP-007 TextInput. Drawn as the sketch's '[ 50 ] ms' (L470), no step buttons.

The window field's well is 24 px tall (`16` §3 L113: a compact field is 24 px; §6.1 L496: every target is ≥ 24 × 24 px), not e18kit field()'s d.row − 4 = 20 px (review/41 #2): e18kit.py is not edited, so the lift is local to this board. The sources row stays 24 px, so the crops, the row's one-line fit and R7's wrap do not move.

No chart panel behind the dialog in either frame: §6.3 L551-552 draws 'the group and the sentence … and nothing else of the dialog', and AC 3 is judged 'from the sentence alone' (L553); boards 07-10 draw the dialog over the chart (L481).

The group sits on a crop of the CMP-043 surface (raised fill, light hairline, radius.dialog, elevation.dialog) padded 24 px (space.dialog.padding) at the dialog's top-left anchor (x 24, y 32: the drawing rail's width and half the 64 px §6.1 L479 leaves, as board 08 places SCR-032), not at its y inside the whole dialog: the crop holds the group alone, and frame 2's open method would run past the dialog's estimated bottom (at compact the whole dialog is about 715 px of the 736 px allowed).

The group keeps the controls column's width (496 px, e18kit CTRL_W), as SCR-032's boards draw it, so R7's sentence wraps as it does in the dialog; the §6.1 sketch runs the Data source rows across the dialog's width (L468-473).

Frame 2's focus ring on the i is a 2 px color.focus.ring inner stroke on its 24 × 24 target (as e18kit's menu() rings a focused item), not k.ring()'s 4 px wrapper, so the sentence keeps its place and its wrap in both frames.

CMP-069's region sits in the note's column under the sentence (x 28 in the group), not at the group's left edge where scr032_source(method=…) appends it: the disclosure's content follows its i and note.

The method's text is not written (copy gap): three bracketed placeholders, each tagged 'E18-D05 (#499)', name the parts §6.3 L548-550 lists, in the spec's own sketch convention for content another ticket owns (L667); type.ui.caption in the dark grey, never the middle grey (kept for T2, §6.5 L614).

`15` CMP-069 (L678: 'opens as CMP-046 Drawer (non-modal)') differs from §6.3 L548 and E18-S05 ('a focusable disclosure, not a hover-only tooltip'): drawn inline, as the spec says. §13 has no A-row for CMP-069, so the conflict is not routed yet. Routing request for the spec author (to raise on PR #4180; this offline round posts nothing, so no A-id exists to cite): an A-row '`15` CMP-069 (678) `opens as CMP-046 Drawer (non-modal)` → in SCR-032 an inline disclosure under its note (E18-S05) → `15` owner'.
Every control, chip, button, field, menu, tooltip, drawer and dialog is a composition named '<CMP id> <Name> (composition)': the wireframes are greys only and cvsheet v1 cannot recolour an instance.

Frames are named as §0 names them ('SCR-030/fp-anatomy'), and cvsheet splits section paths on '/', so frame() names the node with U+2215 '∕' for '/' while sections address inside it; the live renderer renames each frame to its §0 name after the board's last section (live check).
data: No chart and no SYNTHETIC cell data on this board; the only number is the window's 50 ms (L470; §6.2 L530 '50 ms drawn').
The default state: Traded volume checked (§6.3 L543 'Traded volume (default)'; §6.2 L529), nothing staged, a session holding recording:write (§1.4).
